title: First Time Seen Remote Monitoring and Management Tool
author: Elastic
description: Adversaries may install legitimate remote monitoring and management (RMM) tools or remote access software on compromised endpoints for command-and-control (C2), persistence, and execution of native commands. This rule detects when a process is started whose name or code signature matches commonly abused RMM or remote access tools. New Terms type: the host.id and process.name pair has not been seen before within the configured 7-day history window.
